text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: All right, today's the day! I'm gonna get all the Umamusume to believe in feng shui!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Let's go, Trainer. ☆ All I have to do is
break it
down so it's easy to understand.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Oh, hey, you over there! ♪ You were
doing great
with your training just now,
but I can see a way to
improve it even
more using feng shui.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
If you want to strengthen the power of
your lucky
direction, you should pay
more attention to the
five elements. For
example—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, like making your steps firmer—just
like this!
choice_data_list: 踏み込みをしっかりと
choice_data_list_en: Make sure each stride is solid.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
See? By forging a deeper connection
with the
earth, you'll naturally build up
your lower body.
So...

text_block_list.name: Student A
text_block_list.text:
W-well... I guess that's not such a bad
idea. But...

text_block_list.name: Student A
text_block_list.text:
It just feels kinda random. And this is
something I
can't afford to be wrong
about, y'know? Anyway,
see ya...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
That's right. You've gotta hang in there
with all
you've got. Like this!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
If you regulate your breathing, you'll be
able to
picture your qi—and that'll let
you focus on
training your grit!

text_block_list.name: Student A
text_block_list.text:
W-well... I guess that's not such a bad
idea. But...

text_block_list.name: Student A
text_block_list.text:
It just feels kinda random. And this is
something I
can't afford to be wrong
about, y'know? Anyway,
see ya...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Wait! C'mon, it's not random!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
...I guess that explains it, though.
They're not
going to believe me if they
think I'm wrong.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Does that mean people trust Acute's
advice more
because it's based on her
real experiences?

text_block_list.name: Student A
text_block_list.text:
Acuuute! I did exactly what you told me
to do
and I still blew it!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh, goodness me. I'm terribly sorry
about that.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
She was wrong! Trainer, Acute gets
things wrong
too!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even if advice is based on personal
experience,
that doesn't necessarily
mean it's correct.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
So it's not about being right or wrong.
They just
trust Acute and not me.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
What am I missing? I really do just want
everyone
to be happy.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Oh, yeah. You're right—she might know.
choice_data_list: ワンダーアキュートに聞いてみたら？

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Acute. Can I talk to you for a
second?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... The reason people trust me?
Well, if I had
to say...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Actually, I have no idea. Why do they trust me so much?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
You don't even know the reason
yourself?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I'm afraid so. All I really do is tell them
my old
stories.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
My past experiences, how I felt, that
sort of
thing.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
There's so much to go over. I remember
when I
finally had the chance to race
against that Falco.
Ooh, she was as
strong as a demon...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: And I was so close to beating her. So very, very close. But I couldn't quite manage it. When I think back to that race...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I remember all the other racers there
too. Like the
one who had come from
the countryside, or the
one who took a
tumble on the turf.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
From rags-to-riches to reeling and
rolling. By
golly, was I surprised to see it
all.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, all I do is share stories of the

Umamusume I've met, just how I
remember them.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't tell you why everyone keeps
coming
back for more. I don't even fancy
myself much of
a storyteller.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
The best I can manage is relaying the
time I've
spent laughing and crying
alongside my fellow
runners.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
You're just... sharing your experiences...
That's
all...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: That's all, and yet... Trainer, just now, I...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I was so absorbed in her story. My heart
was
pounding.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: How did that happen? And why?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I think I've figured it out. The difference
between
Copano Rickey and Wonder
Acute is...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: "Credibility"?
choice_data_list_en: Maybe it's a difference in trust.
Could be a difference in trust.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's not about being right or wrong.
Umamusume
dedicate their lives to
racing.
choice_data_list: そう、血の通った話だから響くんだ
そう、血の通った話だから響くんだよ
choice_data_list_en: Right, it resonates because it's a heartfelt story.
Right, it resonates because it's a heartfelt story.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That's why they trust stories based on
lived
experience. If they buy into
fantasy, they'll just
be left with regret.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I get it. So ordinary people believed
what I said
about feng shui because they
thought it was fun...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
But the serious runners are different.
They won't
be convinced unless a story
has a strong dragon
vein—a living,
breathing truth behind it...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
It's not about how easy it is to
understand, or how
accurate it is. I can
try as many different
approaches as I
want...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
But unless I make a real breakthrough,
they'll
never accept my feng shui.
Especially not the
racers who are the
most lost.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I don't quite have the full picture,
Rickey, but
whatever it is, remember to
pace yourself, okay?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
You're a good girl, so I'm sure you'll
figure things
out before long.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Yeah. Thanks, Acute.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I've got it. I know what to do
now.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
An unknowable future can't compete
with real
past experiences. Feng shui's
not suited for that.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She sounds a little dejected. Maybe this

realization has left her in low spirits.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: But there's something else that can compete.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Isn't there, Trainer?!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: I'm talking about the present. The moment we're living in. The world right in front of us.
choice_data_list_en: Um, what's this thing you can win at?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
If I can prove what feng shui can do right
before
everyone's eyes, I'm sure they'll
believe in
me—just like they believe in
Acute!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
All I have to do is make myself the
compass that
points to where the qi
flows!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her expression is bright and her gaze
sharp. I can
really see the twinkle of a
dragon's eye in hers.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna do it, Trainer. Just wait and
see.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
No more talk of shifting our focus away
from
racing. This feeling—this hope—it's
not meant to
be conveyed through
words...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I need to show everyone with my actions!
I'll pour
it into my running and rock
everyone who watches
me down to their
cores!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I'll improve my running in time for the
Champions
Cup, and then...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna catch up to Tarumae! It
doesn't matter
how far ahead of me she
is! I'm gonna prove that
my feng shui's
the real deal!
